description_en: Enable or disable the certificate feature for a domain name
description_zh: 设置某域名下证书功能是否启用
kebab_example: aliyun vs set-vs-domain-certificate --domain-name example.aliyundoc.com --ssl-protocol on --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetVsDomainCertificate

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name to which the certificate belongs.

The domain must use HTTPS acceleration
parameters.help_zh:
指定证书所属加速域名。

域名需要属于HTTPS加速类型
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
Whether to enable the HTTPS certificate. Valid values:

on: Enable.

off (default): Disable
parameters.help_zh:
HTTPS证书是否启用。取值：

on：启用。
off（默认值）：不启用
parameters.name: ssl_protocol

parameters.help_en:
The certificate type.

upload: Upload certificate

cas: Alibaba Cloud Security certificate

free: Personal test certificate (Free Edition)
parameters.help_zh:
证书类型。
upload（上传证书）
cas（云盾证书）
free（个人测试证书（免费版））
parameters.name: cert_type

parameters.help_en: The public certificate content. Omit this parameter if you disable the certificate. Provide the certificate content if you configure a certificate
parameters.help_zh: 安全证书内容，不启用证书则无需输入，配置证书请输入证书内容
parameters.name: ssl_pub

parameters.help_en: The private key content. Omit this parameter if you disable the certificate. Provide the private key content if you configure a certificate
parameters.help_zh: 私钥内容，不启用证书则无需输入，配置证书请输入私钥内容
parameters.name: ssl_pri

parameters.help_en: Set to 1 to skip the certificate name duplication check and overwrite an existing certificate with the same name
parameters.help_zh: 设置为1时，忽略证书名称重复的校验，覆盖原有同名证书信息
parameters.name: force_set
